defs: adj	Having traits or characteristics in common; alike, allied, comparable.
n	That which is similar to, or resembles, something else, as in quality, form, etc.
adj	(mathematics) Having the same shape, in particular, having corresponding angles equal and corresponding line segments proportional.
adj	(mathematics, linear algebra) Of two square matrices; being such that a conjugation sends one matrix to the other.
n	(homeopathy) A material that produces an effect that resembles the symptoms of a particular disease.
adj	Misspelling of similar. [Having traits or characteristics in common; alike, allied, comparable.]
N	(for "similar to lactation") a brand of infant formula that was developed by Alfred Bosworth of Tufts University and marketed by Abbott Laboratories.
n	(archaic) One who pretends to be what he is not; one who, or that which, simulates or counterfeits something; a pretender.
n	Dated form of scimitar. [A sword of Persian origin that features a curved blade.]
